transcript_text:
Eve: The Incident Response runbook should start with paging the on-call, not with opening the ticket. Move the on-call page step to the top.
Frank: Yes, on-call paging first.

confluence_workspace_pages.title: Incident Response
confluence_workspace_pages.content_html:
Procedure

  1. Open the incident ticket.
  2. Page the on-call engineer.
  3. Assemble the response team.
  4. Begin mitigation.
